results.text: Mechanism of dexmedetomidine protection against cisplatin induced acute kidney injury in rats. This study explored the molecular mechanisms by which dexmedetomidine (Dex) alleviates cisplatin (CP)-induced acute kidney injury (AKI) in rats. CP-induced AKI models were established, and Dex was intraperitoneally injected at different concentrations into rats in the model groups.
